source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-316–320 complete Volume 16 with tool/clone-mediated transmission, water/media/facility reservoirs, postharvest microbes and mycotoxin context, resistance/susceptibility, and disease-incident records/eradication review. Evidence is bounded so mechanical or clonal association is separated from proven transmission, reservoir detection from plant infection, mycotoxin-capable taxa from measured toxin, genotype response from universal resistance, and symptom resolution from verified incident closure.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 16 with transmission pathways, environmental reservoirs, postharvest microbial context, resistance/susceptibility, and traceable incident review.
